data.title: bn-i7w: Unify console tooling into one binary
data.description: Replaces console-agent and console-pack with the single console CLI, renames stdio JSON-RPC to console rpc, embeds the default pack assets, adds console pack and live-reloading console serve <cart>, removes the old pack crate, and migrates tests/docs/skill/install recipes.

data.body: HIGH: The loopback-default server accepts an arbitrary HTTP Host because read_request returns only method/target and never validates the Host header. A page opened from an attacker-controlled rebinding hostname can therefore fetch this loopback service as same-origin and read the complete packed response, including the user's local cart source and any custom template/engine. Preserve and validate Host for the default loopback binding (accept the printed loopback authority/localhost forms; reject unrelated hosts), with an explicit policy for opt-in non-loopback binds, and add a regression that sends Host: attacker.example to a 127.0.0.1 listener.

HIGH: The first successful page request does not re-read the cart: run_server caches initial_bundle and handle_connection takes it before calling pack::bundle. I reproduced this by starting serve with title 'Before Fetch', editing the cart to 'After Fetch' before any connection, then fetching twice; the first response still contained <title>Before Fetch and only the second contained After Fetch. This contradicts SPEC/README/help's guarantee that cart and overrides are re-read for every page request, so the first refresh after a saved edit can be stale. Keep startup validation if desired, but discard its HTML and call pack::bundle for every GET/HEAD page response; add an edit-before-first-fetch regression.

data.reason: Two HIGH serve correctness/security issues: default-loopback Host is not validated, and the first page response can serve a stale startup bundle instead of rebundling.

data.body: Fixed in 9e5c26d. Request parsing now requires exactly one nonempty Host header and validates its authority/actual listener port before serving HTML. Specific binds require the configured host; wildcard binds accept IP literals only. Unrelated hosts receive 421 without cart content. Added unit coverage plus a real loopback request using Host: attacker.example.

data.reason: fixed with Host authority validation and regression

data.body: Fixed in 9e5c26d. Startup still validates before binding but its Bundle is discarded; every GET/HEAD page request now calls pack::bundle. The refresh test now edits after startup but before the first request, then edits again before the second, and requires both responses to be current.

data.reason: fixed by rebundling every page request with first-fetch regression

LGTM after re-review: arbitrary/wrong-port/IPv6 authorities return 421 without cart content; duplicate Host returns 400; startup bundle is discarded and first plus later page requests rebundle current files. Focused server integration and unit suites pass.
